desc: Prove structural lemmas for connectivity and positive-weight optimal paths in interval disjointness graphs, including the induced-\(P_5\)-free claim.
Reduce direct and one-intermediate path costs to endpoint tests and prefix/suffix minima.
Derive an implicit, non-quadratic data structure or offline sweep for each two-intermediate orientation.
Determine an exact multi-query preprocessing strategy, including disconnected cases and complexity bounds.
Implement the full algorithm in Python and validate against the samples.
